answer: Cross-epoch reply-graph anchoring: each identity's replies form a signed graph, and an epoch's token counts only if its links overlap the prior epoch's by a threshold. Fresh identities start at zero weight, so a sybil must first build a quill of genuine threads, spending weeks of real interaction. Splitting into many identities multiplies that ramp cost. Each cycle also requires passing a nectar exchange test: answering prior links with matching context, verified by hashes. Identities that fail decay like juniper shedding needles, losing all accrued weight.
